title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Lingaa
desc: Lingaa, a petty thief, turns over a new leaf after realising the role his grandfather has played in building a dam for the villagers. He then dedicates his life to saving it from a corrupt minister.

title: Jung
desc: Arjun Saxena, a police officer, is at odds with his younger brother Ajay, a defence lawyer, because of a client that Ajay believes is innocent of the charges incurred.

desc: Post his transfer to a village, an encounter specialist sets out to stop a crime boss who wants to build a power plant in the region despite strong public opposition.

title: I

title: Makkhi
desc: After reincarnating as a fly, a murderer decides to take revenge on his rival, who killed him, and teams up with a woman to destroy the killer's life.
